story_text:
## Meet HALO-5
## See What Real Users Say
## Why HALO-5
What if one intelligent machine could solve all of that - multiplying your creative power into serious productivity? You don't need workarounds - you need a breakthrough. Meet HALO-5.
## 5-Needle Auto Color Change
Say goodbye to tedious, error-prone manual thread swaps. With its 5-needle automatic color-change system, HALO-5 runs up to 5 colors continuously in a single, uninterrupted pass - drastically boosting your productivity.
From smooth transitions to crisp, layer-by-layer precision, HALO-5 translates your most complex vision into striking, professional-grade embroidery.
## Embroider Anything
Clothes, caps, shoes, socks, or pockets - if you can frame it, you can profit from it. HALO-5 delivers the industrial-grade versatility your custom business needs to create anything your customers demand.
Say goodbye to risky cap embroidery. Our dedicated cap frame locks in placement and perfectly flattens curved cap surfaces. Optimized needle clearance ensures bold designs on any cap style without needle breakage.
With specialty frames designed for tight, awkward spaces, HALO-5 lets you easily customize socks, pant legs, and tricky pockets that standard machines can't touch.
## In-App Auto-Digitizing
Stop wasting hours wrestling with complex digitizing programs. From your screen straight to the needle, our mobile auto-digitizing app processes your artwork into production-ready stitches with a single tap.
No PC required. From image to stitch, our mobile app converts your artwork into ready-to-embroider paths and beams it straight to HALO-5 in seconds.
See the final results before the needle even drops. Preview the fully simulated thread paths on screen before pressing start.
HALO-5's onboard library offers diverse categories to match any customer demand. Pick a style, tap the screen, and start creating.
Engineered to surpass basic digitizing tools, HALO-5 delivers crisp details, balanced density, and smooth, professional-grade stitch paths every time.
For intricate designs needing a human touch, request expert manual digitizing right in the HALO App. Available on demand for a modest fee, unlocking ultra-fine details and flawless embroidery precision.
Experience how intuitive the HALO App really is! Our auto-digitizing workflow transforms your artwork into stitch-ready files with just a few taps.
Development of the HALO App is fully complete, and we are now dedicating the next two months to rigorous fine-tuning, bug fixing, and performance optimization. Rest assured, by the time your HALO-5 lands on your doorstep, the app will be thoroughly perfected and available on both iOS and Android.
## Massive 10×16" Stitch Area
Stitch bigger with a massive 10×16" area and a 100M total stitch capacity (30M per design), allowing you to complete hyper-detailed, large-scale masterpieces in one go without splitting.
## Effortless Portability
Professional embroidery has never been this agile. Weighing just 66 lbs, HALO-5 packs industrial-grade power into a lightweight, ultra-compact frame, letting you shift locations and set up your workspace effortlessly.
Traditional commercial machines require a dedicated room and heavy machinery transport. HALO-5 breaks the mold. It combines industrial-grade output into a compact, space-saving design that fits seamlessly onto any studio desk or workspace - without sacrificing stitching precision.
We've added dedicated side handles to HALO-5. Now you have a secure, comfortable grip to move your machine effortlessly, wherever and whenever you need it.
We've redesigned our cap frame for quick installation. Easily snap your hat into place - maximizing your efficiency on every run.
## Industrial Endurance
Powered by a heavy-duty brushless motor, HALO-5 delivers non-stop 24/7 operation with high-speed precision. Tackle back-to-back orders with zero overheating and industrial stability.
HALO-5's commercial-grade DC brushless main-shaft motor ensures cool, stable, and relentless performance for your longest production days.
Hit up to 1,000 SPM on garments and 800 SPM on caps. Cut production times in half while keeping every detail factory-crisp.
Watch the video below to see how HALO-5 captures every tiny detail with crisp, ultra-precise stitching.
## 🎬See HALO-5 in Action
## 📈Revenue Engine
At HALO, we know HALO-5 isn't just an embroidery machine; It's a revenue generator for your business. Launch your embroidered merch shop on Etsy, Shopify, Amazon, or eBay - HALO-5 can pay for itself in just under 3 months.
## 👥100% Community Approved
Every week, we let our Facebook community vote on custom designs and stitch the winning patterns on video. Take a look at the real reviews from our members - see why backers trust HALO-5 long before launch!
## 🌟Why HALO-5 Stands Out

risks: HALO-5 is not our first embroidery machine. Our parent company has spent years building industrial and commercial embroidery equipment sold into more than 100 countries, and HALO-5 runs on that same mechanical architecture. Volume production, quality control, and after-sales service are things we already do. That said, every hardware campaign carries real risk, and here is where ours sits. Production and timeline. HALO-5 is a new chassis built for the home, not a re-badged industrial head. Tooling, the cap frame jig, and the final assembly line all need to be validated at volume before we ship a single unit. Component lead times, particularly for control boards and touchscreens, can move. If we hit a delay, we will post an update the week we know about it. Software. The photo-to-stitch digitizing engine is the part of this product that will keep improving after delivery. The core engine works today, but embroidery is unforgiving. Very fine gradients, hairline type, and photographic detail will still need manual adjustment, and we would rather say that now than have you find out at unboxing. The app and machine firmware both update over the air. Certification and freight. North American units require FCC and UL-relevant certification before they can ship, and testinsg is in progress. Ocean freight rates and tariff schedules are outside our control and have moved sharply over the past two years. We have budgeted conservatively, but we cannot promise those costs hold flat. Support. A multi-needle machine in a living room is a different support problem than one in a workshop. We are building written documentation, video tutorials, and remote diagnostics that let our technicians look at your machine with your permission, so a stopped machine becomes a support call instead of a return shipment.

faq.q: What is Kickstarter, and what does it mean to back a project (pledge)?
faq.a:
Kickstarter is a launchpad for creators to raise funds for the initial production of their invention. Backers (that's you!) can support the creator by pre-ordering the product at a discounted price.
When you back a project, you’re pre-ordering the product. That means you'll get it once it's produced. Besides getting the product itself, you're also joining a community. Follow along the production process, take part in important surveys, and give the creator valuable feedback.

faq.q: How do I pledge (back a project)?
faq.a: In order to pledge, click the green button that says 'Back this project'. You'll get to select your shipping country and choose your desired pledge level and reward.
Your money will be collected only after the project ends. Your card won't be charged until the project ends. If the project is cancelled for any reason, you won't be charged.

faq.q: Does HALO provide local after-sales support?
faq.a: We have dedicated after-sales support systems in place across North America (including the US and Canada), Europe, and Australia. Also, we are actively expanding our support network to more countries and regions worldwide. If any part gets damaged, simply ship it to our service center in your region, and we'll repair or replace it and send it right back to you. Additionally, we provide 1-on-1 remote online assistance to ensure you get personal, step-by-step guidance whenever you need it.

faq.q: What is the warranty period for HALO-5?
faq.a: HALO-5 includes a 1-year free standard warranty. Backers who place a deposit will receive an extra year of coverage, bringing it to 2 years total.
Shipping for HALO-5 is scheduled to begin in January 2027. Please note that for backers using the installment plan, your machine will be shipped once all 3 payments have been successfully completed.

faq.q: Do the prices on Kickstarter include tax, customs fees, and shipping?
faq.a: Reward prices shown on Kickstarter do not include shipping fees. We will collect your shipping fee and delivery address after the campaign ends via our Backer Survey. However, our shipping rates are DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), meaning all local taxes and customs duties are already included in the shipping fee. You will not be charged any extra hidden fees or taxes upon delivery!

Yes. Weighing just 66 lbs, HALO-5 is designed for easy transport. We’ve equipped both sides of the machine with built-in ergonomic handles, making it effortless to lift, move, and bring your creative projects anywhere you go.

faq.q: What is the maximum embroidery area of HALO-5?
faq.a: HALO-5 features a generous maximum embroidery area of 10″ × 16″ (250 mm × 400 mm), giving you ample room to craft large back-jacket designs, quilt panels, and intricate multi-element patterns without needing to re-hoop.

faq.q: Does HALO-5 support designs with more than 5 colors?
faq.a: Yes. HALO-5 supports theoretically unlimited colors per design, with up to 5 colors active at a time for automatic color changes. If your artwork requires more than 5 colors, you can easily pause and swap thread spools to achieve as many colors as you need.

Yes. HALO-5 is compatible with Mighty Hoops. We are currently collaborating directly with their engineering team to finalize exact sizing and bracket specifications. Development and testing are expected to take about 1 to 2 months, and we will share official updates as soon as integration is complete.
Yes. HALO-5 is beginner-friendly. We provide a detailed user manual alongside step-by-step video tutorials for every operation. Plus, we offer 1-on-1 remote online assistance whenever you need help!

Auto-digitizing is like 'one-click magic' for embroidery! It lets software automatically convert your images into machine-ready embroidery files without needing to learn complex manual digitizing from scratch. It saves you tons of time.

faq.q: Can HALO-5 replace traditional 10 or 15-needle commercial machines?
faq.a: HALO-5 is a great alternative to large, heavy 10-needle or 15-needle commercial embroidery machines, especially for small businesses, home studios, and crafters! Weighing just 59 lbs, it's portable enough to take to pop-up events, markets, or craft shows for live embroidery. One of our core design philosophies is bringing traditional commercial performance into a compact, home-and-studio-friendly footprint.

faq.q: What is the maximum stitching speed (SPM) of HALO-5?
faq.a: HALO-5 reaches a maximum speed of up to 1,000 SPM (Stitches Per Minute). For cap embroidery, it operates at an optimized speed of 800 SPM.
